title: Bias library (4): six more niche biases
objectives: Recognise authority, framing, gambler's fallacy, endowment, present bias and the distributor's own bias.
Say how to answer each, including the distributor's own.
body_md:
Authority: “A big YouTuber recommended this.” Say: “Let's check if they're SEBI-registered and whether it fits your plan.” Framing: reacts differently to “90% chance of gain” and “10% chance of loss”. Say: present risk both ways, and in rupees. Gambler's fallacy: “It's risen 5 months straight, it must fall now.” Say: “Markets have no memory. Stick to your allocation.” Endowment: “I inherited these shares, I can't sell them.” Say: “Would you buy them today with fresh money? If not, they may not fit your plan.” Present bias: “I'll start investing after I buy the new car.” Say: “Even a small SIP now buys years of compounding you can't get back.” Distributor's own bias (internal): “This fund is hot, every client should get it.” Say: use the suitability checklist for every recommendation.

| Bias | How it sounds | What to say |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Authority | "A big YouTuber recommended this." | "Let's check if they're SEBI-registered and whether it fits your plan." |
| Framing | Reacts differently to "90% chance of gain" and "10% chance of loss" | Present risk both ways, and in rupees. |
| Gambler's fallacy | "It's risen 5 months straight, it must fall now." | "Markets have no memory. Stick to your allocation." |
| Endowment | "I inherited these shares, I can't sell them." | "Would you buy them today with fresh money? If not, they may not fit your plan." |
| Present bias | "I'll start investing after I buy the new car." | "Even a small SIP now buys years of compounding you can't get back." |
| Distributor's own bias | (Internal) "This fund is hot, every client should get it." | Use the suitability checklist for every recommendation. |
example: “A big YouTuber recommended this” → authority: check SEBI registration and whether it fits the plan.
say: Present risk both ways, and in rupees.
Markets have no memory. Stick to your allocation.
never: A rising streak means a fall must come now.
